verdict.rationale: Square documents a List Payouts API endpoint and an official MCP server through which an agent can call Square APIs. The official TypeScript SDK and an llms.txt support programmatic, agent-driven access to payment data. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of listing payments/transactions (the SDK snippet only shows payment creation), payout-entry or fee-level detail for line-by-line reconciliation, documented ledger/accounting export support, and independent hands-on corroboration of an agent reconciliation workflow.
